summary_en: 50,000 shares (0.7% of S/O) up to ¥45M. Execution 17 Aug – 12 Nov 2026. Method: open-market acquisition under trading-mandate agreement. Rationale: strategic capital allocation based on investment opportunities, financial position and share price.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, the board of Commerce One Holdings Inc. (TSE Growth, ticker 4496) authorized the acquisition of up to 50,000 shares (0.7% of 6,899,451 shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum total outlay of ¥45M. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase under a trading-mandate agreement (取引一任契約に基づく市場買付) during the window 17 August to 12 November 2026. The company stated the decision reflects strategic capital allocation, considering investment opportunities, financial position, and prevailing share valuations. No price ceiling per share is disclosed in the notice. As of 14 August 2026, the company held 293,949 treasury shares.
